documents.title: Edhi Foundation – Pakistan’s Largest Charity
paragraphs: The Edhi Foundation is a worldwide charity that helps people with healthcare, education, and social welfare, following the example of Abdul Sattar Edhi, aiming to ease the suffering of those in need.

Edhi Foundation is a top charitable organization in Pakistan and a global leader in social welfare. Operating on a non-commercial, non-political, and non-communal basis, it provides round-the-clock service without discrimination based on color, class, or creed. Mr. Abdul Sattar Edhi and Mrs. Bilquis Edhi have received numerous awards and shields from governmental and non-governmental organizations at national and international levels for their outstanding humanitarian services across various fields.

Abdul Sattar Edhi's compassionate efforts left a lasting legacy in healthcare and child welfare. He saved newborns by placing cradles outside Edhi centers and provided care for abandoned babies. His impact included supporting disabled individuals, women, and the elderly, offering free medical help through mobile dispensaries, hospitals, and a diabetic center. Edhi also facilitated swift transportation for accident victims with ambulance services.

Abdul Sattar Edhi has provided national and international relief aid to those affected by natural disasters, assistance to refugees in different countries, and emergency services for drought, fire, and flood victims.

His efforts also involved saving lives of drowning victims and recovering bodies from seas and floods. Additionally, he played a key role in free rehabilitation for drug addicts, tracing missing individuals, arranging marriages for helpless girls and boys, and providing free food, clothing, and blankets to those in need.

In addition to the mentioned contributions, Abdul Sattar Edhi served humanity by providing free technical education to empower people with essential skills, offering religious education to children, and giving guidance on family planning and maternity services. He also supplied free blood and plasma to those in need and provided shelter, food, and care for mentally retarded individuals, as well as orphaned and helpless children.

The humanitarian efforts of Abdul Sattar Edhi and his spouse, Mrs. Bilquis Edhi, go beyond these areas. They offered free legal aid to secure the release of prisoners, extending financial and medical support to them. Additionally, they provided crutches and support to handicapped individuals and offered exclusive free bathing and shrouding services for unclaimed dead bodies.
All these remarkable services exemplify the Edhi Foundation's unprecedented dedication to serving the nation of Pakistan and humanity worldwide.

Edhi Foundation has made a big difference in Pakistan. We have changed how we help each other by focusing on "Live and Help Live." With a big team of caring people, the Edhi Foundation is known for being there for others. We do lots of good things, like helping with burials for those who don't have anyone else, giving a place to stay for people who are disabled or homeless, and running free hospitals in areas that need them.

We also help people struggling with drugs and quickly help out in emergencies. What's special is that the Edhi Foundation doesn't rely on the government or big organizations for money - We depend on regular people's donations. We believe in helping ourselves and treating everyone fairly, regardless of religion, background, or where they're from.
Transforming Lives Through Compassionate Service and Support
Our vision at the Edhi Foundation is simple yet powerful: we want to make life better for everyone, no matter who they are or where they come from.

We dream of a world where every child has a loving home and every sick person can get the help they need. We believe in a society where people are kind to each other and help their neighbors when they need it.

We hope to see a future where education is free for all children so they can learn and grow. We dream of communities where people take care of each other, where nobody goes hungry, and everyone has a place to live. We want to make sure that people with disabilities are supported and included, and that nobody is left behind because of their situation.

We're dedicated to spreading this vision everywhere, in Pakistan and beyond. We know it won't happen quickly, but with hard work, we believe we can create a world where everyone can thrive. Together, we can make this vision a reality, one small act of kindness at a time.
Along with these goals, we also want to see a society where everyone is treated with respect, no matter who they are or what they believe.

We want to create a culture where people understand and accept each other, where we celebrate our differences, and discrimination is a thing of the past. By promoting understanding and unity, we think we can make a better future for everyone.

We are committed to delivering exceptional ambulance services that combine speed, reliability, and compassion. Every call is a promise to provide urgent medical care with professionalism and a steadfast dedication to saving lives.

The Edhi Land Ambulance Service started with a used Hillman Pickup Truck that was converted into the very first ambulance, named the "Poor Patient Ambulance." After sixty years, Edhi's fleet of ambulances has expanded tremendously, now boasting over 1800 vehicles deployed throughout Pakistan.
From its humble beginnings, the service has grown into the largest ambulance fleet globally, catering to the medical needs of communities far and wide.

The Edhi Air Ambulance Service is equipped with two planes and a helicopter, all set to provide rapid assistance during natural disasters. Their mission is to quickly airlift and transport injured or stranded individuals to nearby hospitals in times of crisis. With a focus on swift response and efficient evacuation, they play a crucial role in saving lives during emergencies.
Their dedicated team ensures that help reaches those in need as quickly as possible, offering crucial support when it's needed most.

The Edhi Marine Ambulance Service operates 28 rescue boats to assist people affected by floods and to search for those in need along the Arabian Ocean coastline. These boats are crucial for rescuing individuals stranded in flood-affected areas and for recovering those who have drowned.
Take the next step to making a difference - support Edhi Foundation's humanitarian efforts!
Expanding Capacity for Unclaimed Coffins and Burials

In this mortuary, there was space to keep only 16 coffins, yet now 30 coffins can be kept simultaneously, as these heirless dead bodies which usually are unidentifiable who have either killed due to bigger accidents, or bomb blast, or firing.

These coffins are kept for 3-4 days in the mortuary, and then they are buried duly displaying their personal bio-date on the tin-slate at the graveyard so that it could be easier to search and find by their heirs. In the Edhi Graveyard, on average 250 to 350 unclaimed dead bodies are being buried on monthly basis. For the burial of a heirless coffin, on average Rs.6000/- expenses do occur. From 1986 to 2008, these unclaimed coffins were buried in the Edhi graveyard. When no space is left to bury any more dead bodies, then a plot measuring to 10 acres were again purchased in 2008 where the heirless remains are being buried there till to date.

Yearly more than 8000 unclaimed coffins are being buried, and the outlay comes to the tune of Rs.8000/- per coffin. In accordance with the record, in Edhi Mwach Goth Graveyard, 96000 unclaimed dead bodies have been buried till now.

paragraphs: Empowering the future generation with care and support, Edhi Foundation's Children's Services provide a nurturing environment where every child's well-being is prioritized.
" Prophet(PBUH) Said-Whoever does not show mercy to our young ones, or acknowledge the rights of our elders, is not one of us." (Sahih Bukhari)

At many Edhi emergency centers, we have baby cradles called "Jhoolas" where unwanted infants can be safely left. These babies are then taken into our care and provided shelter in Edhi Homes. Over time, more people have come to accept this service, and some even bring babies directly to our centers. We carefully assess and select suitable families for adoption, ensuring the well-being of the child.

Bilquis Edhi oversees this process, ensuring that adopting parents are suitable and conducting regular follow-ups. Babies found abandoned in garbage dumps around Karachi are brought to our central nursery for medical care before adoption. We keep all records confidential to protect the child's privacy.

Edhi Foundation's Abandoned Children Services provide a safe haven for vulnerable children who have been abandoned or left without proper care. With dedicated staff and facilities across the country, we ensure these children receive the love, support, and protection they deserve.

Through our comprehensive programs, we strive to reunite them with their families whenever possible or find loving homes through adoption. Join us in safeguarding the well-being and future of these precious children.

The Edhi Child Adoption Centre and childcare services began in 1949. Mrs. Bilquis Edhi oversees the care and feeding of babies and children. Cradles are placed outside all Edhi Centres across the country to keep abandoned and illegitimate babies safe.

These babies are often given to childless couples after a careful screening process to ensure they are suitable for adoption. Bilquis Edhi thoroughly reviews the backgrounds of the couples before deciding if they are a good fit for adoption.
Take the next step to making a difference - support Edhi Foundation's humanitarian efforts!
Centre offers a supportive learning environment where students can thrive and develop their talents.

At Edhi Foundation, we believe that every child deserves access to quality education and opportunities for growth. That's why we focus on offering a range of enrichment programs to support their development. Our commitment extends beyond traditional schooling to include a variety of activities that nurture their talents and interests.

Through our educational initiatives, we ensure that children have access to well-equipped classrooms, qualified teachers, and a supportive learning environment. Whether it's mastering basic literacy and numeracy skills or exploring subjects like science and the arts, we strive to provide a comprehensive education that prepares them for success.

In addition to academic learning, we offer extracurricular activities that encourage creativity, critical thinking, and teamwork. From sports and arts programs to vocational training and life skills workshops, we aim to broaden their horizons and equip them with practical skills for the future.

At the heart of our Education and Enrichment Programs is the belief that every child has unique talents and potential waiting to be unlocked. By providing a holistic approach to education, we empower children to pursue their passions, overcome obstacles, and achieve their dreams, ensuring a brighter future for generations to come.
Empowering children's futures with Edhi Foundation's care, providing essential support and educational opportunities to nurture young minds.

Through our healthcare and nutrition initiatives, we provide essential medical care and nutritious meals to support the growth and development of every child under our care.

paragraphs: Empowering futures through accessible education: Edhi Education Service transforms lives one student at a time.
" Prophet(PBUH) Said-Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim" (Ibn Majah)

Edhi Foundation extends its educational outreach by operating elementary and primary secondary schools in Karachi, notably in areas including Old Sabzi Mandi, Noor Shah Colony Mirphur Khaas, and Masjid Road Nawabshah. These schools serve as vital educational hubs, especially for communities residing in remote regions of Sindh, ensuring access to fundamental education for all children.
Through these efforts, Edhi Foundation continues its mission of empowering communities through education.
Mission ​ of Edhi Education Service

Edhi Education Service is dedicated to a simple yet powerful mission – ensuring that every child, irrespective of their background, has the opportunity to receive a quality education. Our commitment is evident through the operation of schools that aim to empower students, equipping them with essential knowledge and skills for a successful life journey.
By breaking down barriers to education, we strive to create a brighter and more promising future for all children under our care.

At Edhi schools, we create an inclusive learning environment that embraces students from various backgrounds. Our doors are open to children from disadvantaged communities, ensuring that no one is left behind in their pursuit of education.

The service plays a vital role in providing timely aid and support to coastal communities during emergencies, ensuring the safety and well-being of those in distress. With a nurturing atmosphere and personalized support, we empower students to excel academically and grow personally, fostering a sense of belonging and confidence in their abilities.

Edhi schools in different parts of Sindh Province make a big difference in the communities they are in. These schools bring education to faraway places, helping the communities grow and improve. By giving people access to education, we help them become stronger and create a culture where learning is important.

Our focus on education in remote areas helps people break free from poverty. Education gives them a chance to learn important skills that can make their lives better. By supporting education, we're building a foundation for long-term success and making these underserved places better.

Edhi schools don't just help with studies; they also teach important life skills like thinking, talking, and working together. This helps bring people together and makes the community stronger. Our goal is not only to help with education but also to inspire positive changes. As students learn and grow, they become leaders in their families and communities, making a positive impact that lasts for a long time.
Empowering communities through education with Edhi Foundation, offering access to learning and skill development for sustained growth.

The foundation runs literacy campaigns and initiatives aimed at promoting education and increasing literacy rates, particularly in marginalized communities where access to education may be limited.

Our commitment to providing respectful burials extends across borders, ensuring that all individuals receive proper farewell rites, regardless of location or circumstance.

Mr. Edhi's remarkable dedication to providing the last prescribed bath (Ghusal) for over 58,000 deceased individuals and unclaimed coffins is recognized worldwide. This monumental effort underscores the Foundation's dedication to upholding the sanctity of life, even in death. By ensuring that each person is laid to rest with dignity and respect, Edhi Foundation honors the inherent value and worth of every human being, regardless of their socioeconomic status or circumstances.

Furthermore, the Foundation's record-breaking burials serve as a testament to its tireless efforts in serving humanity and alleviating suffering. paragraphs: Transform lives with a click! Your Zakat has the power to create lasting change.
Every penny goes directly to those who need it most.​

Zakat, a pillar of Islam, is a compulsory form of charity where Muslims donate a portion (usually 2.5%) of their wealth to help the less fortunate. During Ramadan, the blessings of giving are multiplied, making it an ideal time to fulfill this obligation.
Zakat is charity Muslims give to help the needy. It's compulsory and calculated based on wealth.
During Ramadan, Zakat becomes even more important to spread blessings and help those in need.
Empower Lives with Edhi Foundation's Ramadan Zakat Appeal
Edhi Foundation's Give Zakat Appeal ensures your contribution brings lasting positive change, aiding healthcare, education, disaster relief, and community development.

Join Edhi Foundation's Ramadan Zakat Appeal to make a profound impact on communities in need. Your Zakat ensures vital services such as healthcare, education, disaster relief, and community development thrive during this auspicious month. Ramadan embodies the spirit of generosity and compassion. Through Edhi Foundation's Zakat Appeal, you can help uplift lives and enact positive change. Your donation provides essential resources for medical treatments, educational initiatives, and rapid response during emergencies.

Together, we can ensure no one is left vulnerable. Your Zakat serves as a lifeline, offering sustainable solutions for those facing hardship. Join us in spreading hope and creating a lasting legacy of compassion this Ramadan.
The Prophet (saw) said that “The Believers Shade On The Day Of Resurrection Will Be His Sadqa” (Hadith Tirmidhi)
Your support not only offers immediate relief but also fosters long-term resilience and empowerment within communities.
Every contribution counts. Your Zakat donation, no matter the size, makes a tangible difference in the lives of those less fortunate.
Together, let's embrace the spirit of Ramadan and extend a helping hand to those in need, ensuring a brighter future for all.
Follow these 6 simple steps to calculate your Zakat correctly.
The Nisab is the minimum wealth required for Zakat. Check gold/silver market values to see if you qualify.
Evaluate your cash, savings, jewelry, business assets, and investments. Exclude personal items like your home.
Subtract any debts or loans from your total assets. Zakat applies only to the remaining net wealth.
After calculating your total assets and subtracting any liabilities, you'll have your Zakatable assets. These are the assets used to calculate Zakat.
Donating Sadqa for healthcare helps fund initiatives offering medical care to those in need. This can involve building hospitals, providing equipment, medical treatments for lasting impact.
Once you've calculated your Zakat, the last step is to pay it to those in need. You can give directly to eligible recipients or contribute to trustworthy organizations that manage Zakat distribution.

Born in 1928 in the small village of Bantva near Joona Garh, Gujrat (India), Abdul Sattar Edhi's journey of compassion began with the seeds planted in his soul during his mother's illness. At the age of eleven, when his mother became paralyzed and later suffered from mental illness, Edhi devoted himself to her care. He undertook the responsibilities of cleaning, bathing, changing clothes, and feeding her. Despite his efforts, the battle against the disease proved to be challenging, and his mother's helplessness grew over the years. This early experience shaped Edhi's lifelong commitment to alleviating the suffering of humanity.

Bilquis Bano Edhi's journey began as a nurse at Edhi Nurses Training Centre. After marrying Abdul Sattar Edhi, they founded the Edhi Foundation, dedicating themselves to aiding Pakistan's impoverished despite financial constraints.

Bilquis Edhi has done a lot of good for people. She got big awards for her work, like the 'Hilal-e-Imtiaz' and the 'Lenin Peace Prize.' She and her husband also got the 1986 Ramon Magsaysay Award for Public Service. She runs the Bilquis Edhi Foundation, which helps many people in Pakistan. They have hospitals and places for emergency care, where they help many people who need it.

The visionary & courageous man who did not take money from the government, he wished to domesticate the habit of giving in the Pakistani people. He finally succeeded. Late Abdus Sattar Edhi's golden words, that often the people who have the least, give the most.When he started his work, he was penniless. He sat on the street and asked for donations not for himself but to help people in greater need. “I begged. And people gave,” he said. From the very beginning, people passing Edhi on the street trusted him to do good with their money.

When your Zakat-eligible wealth surpasses the Nisab for a full lunar year, Zakat is due immediately. It becomes an annual obligation if your wealth remains above the Nisab.
Donate your Zakat with confidence through Edhi Foundation, ensuring it reaches where it's needed most. Trusted for over 30 years, our projects are Zakat-applicable, sustainable, and impactful.
Items, except gold or silver not bought for resale, are not subject to Zakat. Personal belongings like a house or car are exempt from Zakat.

Sadqa manifests in various forms, including donating money to charities, aiding the needy, or feeding the hungry. This practice of sadqa meaning, rooted in Islamic teachings for centuries, is a vital aspect of leading a virtuous life.

Sadqa refers to any selfless act of kindness without expecting anything in return. Sadaqatul jariya, on the other hand, is a lasting form of kindness, a gesture that keeps giving even after you're no longer present.
This frequently involves financing the building of a water well or water plant, planting useful trees like fruits and olives, or aiding in the construction of a masjid or any other medical facility.

paragraphs: We are a Registered and Recognised Entity

CHHIPA WELFARE, a non-profit welfare organization in Pakistan, imbued with a noble mission, having sincere love and affection for the humanity and a strong commitment to serve the COMMON PEOPLE without discrimination of any caste, creed or colour under all circumstances, where frequent road accidents, sudden events and emergencies daily occur.

The beacon of these enormous services started with a small fleet of ambulances. documents.title: Chhipa Ambulance | Chhipa Welfare Association®
paragraphs: The dynamic, dedicated fleet of Chhipa Ambulances-on life saving missions, on alert 24/7

CHHIPA AMBULANCE. The beacon of the enormous humanitarian services of Chhipa Welfare Association, with the largest fleet of highly dedicated fleet of ambulances, manned by paramedics and equipped with first aid box and oxygen cylinder, spread over CHHIPA AMBULANCE EMERGENCY CENTRES located at prominent places, at various roundabouts and near Government Hospitals across Mega City of Karachi and other regions of Pakistan, on alert––around the clock all year around––for Rapid

Rescue and Relief, providing immediate help and assistance to the needy, the seriously injured victims of road accidents, train collisions, disasters and calamities, shifting the sick, people suffering and emergency patients, rushing them to hospitals and medical facilities, while the responding time is within 05 minutes, which further initiates the rescue operation without any delay. Chhipa Ambulances are always on the alert and ready to face any untoward emergency situation.PK

In frequent road accidents, sudden disasters, pandemics, heat stroke, bomb blasts, firing, stampede, heavy rains, train collisions, building and bridge collapse, unexpected incidents and emergencies, Chhipa Ambulances, hurriedly rush and always reach the incident spots FIRST, to the rescue of people who are suffering and for providing them immediate help. Normally, Chhipa Ambulances––24 hours/7 days a week––remain engaged on roads in lifting and shifting the seriously injured victims of road accidents, the needy, the sick, burnt out and severed body parts, emergency patients, partially decomposed and unidentified abandoned, decomposed and mutilated bodies, lying in drains and sewers, dead bodies––to hospitals & medical centres in attempts to save the valuable human lives, all taken care off by Chhipa Volunteers. The Rescue Team of Chhipa Ambulance daily saves numerous precious human lives.

documents.title: Chhipa Ration | Chhipa Welfare Association®
paragraphs: In these hard times and rising costs, poor families suffer the most. Due to poverty they lack the funds to meet their day-to-day necessities of life i.e. food, clothing and education. In order to lessen their sufferings, Chhipa Monthly Ration took upon the humanitarian task to become the Custodian for such indigent families.

Chhipa Welfare gives the utmost priority to ensure their provisions of food, clothing and education and provide these deserving families with Chhipa Monthly Ration . Also, mandatorily maintaining the respect for their self-esteem––which is never compromised under any circumstances or cost.

In order to provide the provisions for monthly support for groceries and sundry, Chhipa Welfare needs large scale financial support for the sustenance of this ongoing humanitarian operation. Chhipa Welfare is a NGO, which is solely dependent on public donations and generous financial support of philanthropists. It will not be out of place to mention here that the number of such deserving families has increased manifold and since the recent past more families are added to the list daily for Chhipa Monthly Ration .

documents.title: Chhipa Morgue | Chhipa Welfare Association®
paragraphs: The Mega City of Karachi has been facing a serious lack of Morgue service in the public sector and certain NGOs have stepped in and filled this gap. The need for a Morgue is unavoidable in a mega city like Karachi, with a population of around 25 million and ever escalating graph of deaths from pandemics, heat waves, blasts, floods, earthquakes, train collisions, disasters and calamities, bridge and road collapses, sectarian and ethnic violence and other incidents.

The horrifying scene of the extreme heat wave that hit Karachi in 2015, saw dead bodies lying everywhere around hospitals. This appalling scene of human tragedy effectuated Social Worker Ramzan Chhipa to speedily move forward for setting up a Morgue.

The need for accommodating the large number of victims of such catastrophes and calamities, the state-of-the-art Chhipa Morgue was set up to cope with such cataclysmic situations and he succeeded in doing it in the shortest period of time. As Pakistan is facing a shortage of energy and with frequent blackouts and load shedding, sometimes for longer spells of hours, there was a dire need to ensure uninterrupted supply of electricity to maintain the interior of the morgue at chilling temperature and to maintain its continuous function, two fully automatic heavy stand-by generators were installed.

documents.title: Chhipa Jhoola | Chhipa Welfare Association®
paragraphs: No one can tolerate the unbearable sight of an unwanted, disbanded new born baby lying in the trash and dumpsters. Some people are also compelled to disown their legitimate child, due to social taboos, poverty, lack of family planning, especially indigent families having many children.

It is the God given right of every child to live and none have the moral or legal right to commit infanticide. It is mostly children born out of wedlock that are victims of such brutal act of murdering the innocent child, which also tantamount to killing the whole humanity.

Social Worker Ramzan Chhipa, who has been proactive and vociferously vocal for the rights of such unwanted children and through years of toiling, created awareness for protection of unwanted children and by his firm conceptualization evolved The Chhipa Jhoola (Cradle) .

His efforts worked wonders and raised the awareness of the people and made them realize the cruelty towards infanticide and discouraged them from throwing any new born (legitimate or illegitimate) in garbage bins, filthy lanes and sewage drains, on any pretext.

Such disbanded infants born out of wedlock and which were mostly preyed upon by stray dogs, wild cats and rodents, did not further prevail as Chhipa Jhoola were set up at all Chhipa Ambulance Emergency Centres across Karachi for placing the unwanted child without any fear and embarrassment or being questioned.

Social Worker Ramzan Chhipa is the first legal guardian until after a married childless couple is handed the infant for adoption. Chhipa Welfare Association maintains the complete record and the legality of all such unwanted children that are placed in Chhipa Jhoola . After the married childless couple has been selected by the Chhipa Adoption Board, the child is then handed over to them in a simple adoption ceremony at the Chhipa Head Office. After that Social Worker Ramzan Chhipa regularly visits the homes of the adopting parents and monitors the well-being and upbringing of the adopted child.

Thereafter, many well-off and educated childless married couples who were interested and willing to adopt such unwanted infants, stepped forward and registered with Chhipa Welfare Association. In waiting, there are innumerable applications for adoption, which after––thorough scrutiny and approval––by Chhipa Adoption Board, are handed the infant for adoption.

documents.title: Chhipa Free Food Dastarkhwan | Chhipa Welfare Association®
paragraphs: In these hard times of poverty, unemployment, low wages amid escalating rate of inflation, the poor people are suffering the most. They find it most difficult to earn enough to feed their kith and kin and provide them with clothing and education.

To offer solace and relief to the poor, CHHIPA FREE FOOD DASTARKHAWAN––located at CHHIPA CENTRES across the city, serves 50,000 meals twice daily to the poor and deserving and those who cannot afford to buy food ––with dignity and upholding their self-respect.

CHHIPA WELFARE ASSOCIATION took upon itself this responsibility for providing free cooked meals to more than 50,000 indigent citizens of Pakistan. For this noble cause, Chhipa Welfare Association established the state-of-the-art CHHIPA KITCHEN with fully automatic bread-baking plant, which works around the clock. Chhipa Welfare Association ensures supply of cooked meals to CHHIPA FREE FOOD DASTARKHAWAN at hundreds of its centres and ambulance booths across Karachi where people in need gather and are served with complete self-respect.
However, for this benevolent cause CHHIPA FREE FOOD DASTARKHAWAN is solely dependent on public donations as it costs millions to feed starving people in large numbers twice daily.

CHHIPA WELFARE ASSOCIATION needs uninterrupted supply of funds required to keep its KICTHEN and CHHIPA FREE FOOD DASTARKHAWAN running for the noble cause of serving humanity and hence, incessantly appeals to the philanthropists and general public at large to add their share, enabling Chhipa Welfare Association to continue with its free-of-cost food programme.

documents.title: Chhipa Orphanage | Chhipa Welfare Association®
paragraphs: CHHIPA ORPHANAGE is set up to care for children in distress who are orphaned and provide them with all the necessities for their upbringing and keep a positive impact on their life. Chhipa Orphanage meets the basic needs of giving them the standard of living and support for their happiness. The need of a safe place to live and pursue their educational and life-skills. Here the focus is on providing the best that every orphan deserves––a healthy start and the opportunity to learn. An effort that will never deprive them of many things and handed boxes with love full of toys, which they treasure. Such gifts make a big difference in their lives and the self perception that someone loves and cares for them. They feel a sense of belonging and acceptance when it all comes from Social Worker Muhammad Ramzan Chhipa by providing his continuous care and support for these orphans in need. Giving them the loving attention as would have been provided by their parents.

Chhipa Orphanage provides education to the orphans––where the curriculum taught––allows them to have greater knowledge and open up opportunities when they become adults. Our aim is to make them successful in life.
The Orphanage is housed in a beautiful building with an integrated kitchen, spacious rooms, a school and a playground. The health, hygiene and safety of the orphans being the utmost priority.
The peers are always aware of introducing new impressions like games and stories. The ethical values give them support, hope and guidance in their young lives.
